name: zilean
description: Connect Claude Code to a Zilean instance over MCP with browser sign-in, pause and resume its automation from slash commands, and wait for running work to drain before maintenance.

url.title: Zilean base URL
url.description: The address of your Zilean instance, for example https://zilean.example.com. Include https:// and leave off any trailing slash or path: the plugin adds /mcp. Do not include a token: a browser window opens for sign-in.
